summary.text: Caroline Harris is a Republican state representative who has represented Texas House District 52 since January 10, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She previously worked as a policy advisor for the Texas State Senate and as a legislative aide in the Texas House.

paragraphs.text: Harris was born in Round Rock, Texas, and earned a graduate degree from the University of Texas Lyndon B. Johnson School of Public Affairs.
Before her election she worked as a policy advisor for the Texas State Senate and as a legislative aide at the Texas House of Representatives.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a conservative and Round Rock native who had advised a state senator for seven years and who teaches Sunday school and serves on the missions board at her church.
Harris succeeded James Talarico in District 52, and for 2023 and 2024 she was assigned to the Insurance and Transportation committees.
Her 2022 campaign messages, as she listed them in the survey, were securing the border, ensuring parents have a say in what children are taught, and supporting police.
She won the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, and faces Democrat Chris Jimenez in the general election.
